title: 30 m/s in km/h
statement: A cheetah runs at 30 m/s. What is its speed in km/h?
explanation: Multiply by 18/5 to go from m/s to km/h: 30 × 18/5 = **108 km/h**.

title: Train at 54 km/h passes a pole in 16 s
statement: A train running at 54 km/h passes a signal pole in 16 seconds. How long is the train?
explanation: Passing a pole, the train covers its own length. Speed = 54 × 5/18 = 15 m/s; length = 15 × 16 = **240 m**.

title: 300 m train, 180 m platform at 108 km/h
statement: A 300 m long train runs at 108 km/h. How long does it take to cross a 180 m long platform completely?
explanation: It must cover its own length plus the platform: 300 + 180 = 480 m at 30 m/s → **16 s**.

title: 300 km in 5 h; how long for 240 km?
statement: A bus covers 300 km in 5 hours. At the same speed, how long will it take to cover 240 km?
explanation: Speed = 300 / 5 = 60 km/h. Time for 240 km = 240/60 = **4 hours**.

title: Round trip at 72 and 36 km/h
statement: A cyclist goes from home to college at 72 km/h and returns along the same route at 36 km/h. What is the average speed for the whole journey?
explanation: Average speed = total distance / total time — not the average of the speeds. For equal distances it is 2xy/(x + y) = 2 × 72 × 36/108 = **48 km/h**.

title: Trains of 180 m and 250 m, 90 and 72 km/h, same direction
statement: Two trains 180 m and 250 m long run on parallel tracks in the same direction at 90 km/h and 72 km/h. How long do they take to cross each other completely?
explanation:
Relative speed = 90 − 72 = 18 km/h = 5 m/s.
Distance to clear = 180 + 250 = 430 m, so time = 430/5 = **86 s**.

title: 24 km downstream in 2 h, upstream in 3 h (boat)
statement: A boat goes 24 km downstream in 2 hours and the same distance upstream in 3 hours. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
explanation:
Downstream speed = 24/2 = 12 km/h; upstream = 24/3 = 8 km/h.
Boat speed = (12 + 8)/2 = 10 km/h; stream speed = (12 − 8)/2 = 2 km/h. Answer: **10 km/h**.

title: 12 km/h late by 12 min, 15 km/h early by 5 min
statement: Walking at 12 km/h, Sana reaches her office 12 minutes late. Walking at 15 km/h, she reaches 5 minutes early. How far is the office?
explanation:
The two journey times differ by 12 + 5 = 17 minutes = 0.28 h.
d/12 − d/15 = 0.28 → d = 0.28 × 12 × 15/(15 − 12) = **17 km**.

title: Meeting point on a 300 km road (20 and 60 km/h, A starts an hour earlier)
statement: Towns P and Q are 300 km apart. A leaves P for Q at 20 km/h and B leaves Q for P at 60 km/h; A starts at 8 a.m. and B at 9 a.m.. How far from P do they meet?
explanation:
By 9 a.m. A has covered 20 km, leaving 280 km. They close the gap at 20 + 60 = 80 km/h, so they meet 3.5 h after 9 a.m..
A has then travelled 20 × 4.5 = **90 km** from P.

title: Round trip of 72 km each way, boat 12 km/h, stream 4 km/h
statement: A motorboat's speed in still water is 12 km/h and the river flows at 4 km/h. How long does it take to go 72 km downstream and come back?
explanation: Downstream 16 km/h: 72/16 = 4.5 h. Upstream 8 km/h: 72/8 = 9 h. Total **13.5 hours** (not 2 × 72/12 — the current doesn't cancel out).

title: Train at 72 km/h passes a man walking towards it at 9 km/h in 8 s
statement: A train running at 72 km/h passes a man walking at 9 km/h towards the train in 8 seconds. How long is the train?
explanation: Relative speed = 72 + 9 = 81 km/h = 22.5 m/s. Length = 22.5 × 8 = **180 m**.

title: Meeting point on a 180 km road (60 and 20 km/h)
statement: Towns P and Q are 180 km apart. A leaves P for Q at 60 km/h and B leaves Q for P at 20 km/h; at the same time. How far from P do they meet?
explanation:

A has then travelled 60 × 2.25 = **135 km** from P.

title: Round trip of 45 km each way, boat 9 km/h, stream 3 km/h
